wynnvoice.unavailable.banned: you are banned from voice chat
wynnvoice.unavailable.notAllowed: you are not on the relay's allowlist
wynnvoice.unavailable.badSession: Mojang did not confirm your session
wynnvoice.unavailable.sessionUnavailable: Mojang's session server could not be reached
wynnvoice.groupsFollowParty: Voice groups follow your Wynncraft party. Use /party instead.
wynnvoice.unsupportedSvcVersion: Your Simple Voice Chat version is not supported, please update it
wynnvoice.command.badTier: Unknown tier. Use party, friends_and_guild or everyone.
wynnvoice.consent.title: WynnVoice Voice Chat
wynnvoice.consent.notSvc: WynnVoice uses your installed Simple Voice Chat mod, but it is a separate mod. Do NOT contact Simple Voice Chat support. Report any issues to the WynnVoice maintainer.
wynnvoice.consent.position: While voice is on, your position is sent to the WynnVoice relay so audio can be routed to nearby players.
wynnvoice.consent.recording: The last 2 minutes of your speech are held in the relay's memory. They are saved only if another player reports you, and only for moderation.
wynnvoice.consent.moderation: Block someone with %1$s block <player>. Report someone with %1$s report <player> [reason]. Reports go to the WynnVoice maintainer, not to Wynncraft staff.
wynnvoice.consent.audience: By default only your party can hear you. Change this with %1$s tier <party|friends_and_guild|everyone>. Cancel turns voice off; you can enable it later with %1$s enable.
wynnvoice.consent.everyone.title: Everyone Audience
wynnvoice.consent.everyone.rules: Everyone mode lets any nearby player hear you and lets you hear them, including strangers. Be respectful: no harassment, slurs, threats or spam. Cancel keeps your audience at party only.
wynnvoice.consent.everyone.report: If someone breaks the rules, report them with %1$s report <player> [reason]. The last 2 minutes of their speech are saved for the WynnVoice moderators. Block them with %1$s block <player>.
wynnvoice.consent.everyone.ban: Breaking these rules gets you banned from WynnVoice. Bans are for the service as a whole, not just for the person you were talking to.
